subject: ROAR sweep — vulcan compute plan
body: Ines — compute plan for the ROAR sweep; want to make sure the books agree with ours. The sweep is 5 estimators × 6 removal fractions × 3 seeds = 90 ImageNet retrainings, plus the base models. We hold the vulcan-h100 reservation for the week of 2026-06-01 — 256 GPUs — and the whole sweep is scheduled against that week: 90 trainings at ~14 h each on 16-GPU slices fits with margin if we keep utilization above 85%. Two asks: (1) confirm no preemption windows that week; (2) confirm the maintenance window we should plan around is still 2026-06-22 to 06-24 — we're deliberately a full three weeks ahead of it, but if June 1 slips we start eating into it. Dev work stays on titan best-effort meanwhile. — Bruno
